title: review-run prune --json
description: Terminal runs older than the duration, by finished_at (deleted or, with --dry-run, would_delete). A running or escalated run is never touched; a terminal run whose teardown is not done is skipped (teardown_pending) so its agent id is not lost, and one with undelivered outbox events is skipped (events_pending) so no hook event or audit record is lost. Exit 0 whatever the per-run results.

reason.description: A closed code for a failed deletion, teardown_pending for a skipped terminal run whose teardown is not done, or events_pending for a skipped terminal run with undelivered outbox events; else null.

warnings.description: prune_failed, present exactly when a result is failed; otherwise empty.
